pages.text: $(bold)Serene Seasons$() adds a full seasonal cycle to the Overworld. Each season lasts several in-game days and affects weather, temperature, and most importantly $(bold)crop growth$().$(br2)The four seasons cycle automatically:$(br)$(li)$(#0a0)Spring$() — crops grow normally$(li)$(#ff0)Summer$() — crops grow at peak rate$(li)$(#f80)Autumn$() — crops grow slowly$(li)$(#88f)Winter$() — outdoor crops $(bold)die$()

$(bold)Winter Crop Death$()$(br2)During winter, most crops planted outdoors will $(bold)fail to grow and eventually break$(). Snow and ice generate naturally across the landscape.$(br2)Some crops are winter-hardy and survive all seasons. Check the $(l:https://sereneseasons.fandom.com)Serene Seasons guide$(/l) or experiment to discover which.$(br2)$(italic)Plan your harvests before autumn ends!$()

$(bold)Bypassing Seasons$()$(br2)Two methods let you farm year-round:$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Thermal Phytogenic Insolator$() — this T2 machine grows crops indoors using RF power, completely ignoring seasonal effects. The ultimate farming solution.$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Underground farms$() — crops grown deep underground or in enclosed spaces may be partially protected, though results vary by crop type.

$(bold)Seasonal Strategy$()$(br2)$(li)In $(#0a0)Spring$() and $(#ff0)Summer$(), plant extensively and stockpile food$(li)In $(#f80)Autumn$(), harvest everything before the frost$(li)In $(#88f)Winter$(), rely on stored food, animal farms, or machine-grown crops$(br2)$(bold)Tip:$() The $(item)Season Calendar$() item shows the current season and sub-season. Craft one early to track the cycle.
